snippet.title: Longplay - Skunny: Save our Pizzas (1993) [MS-DOS]
snippet.description:
Meet Skunny a squirrel with attitude! Skunny has been given the job of getting back the recipe of the Pizza that has been stolen by the "Evil Chef Of Cadiz". Skunny must travel back in time to ancient Rome to retrieve the recipe. On his final mission he must confront the "Chef Of Cadiz" and do battle with the crazed chef whom was once described as "A person you could feed your mother in law to!"

This platformer game caught my attention one year ago during my "Obscure platform games"-Livestream. I had to see the end of thise game. One year later I finally did it. I ill-advise you to ever check out this game. It's cluncky, it's buggy, it's filled with cheap-hits and 50% of the time the game just screws you over. You have been warned.

Check out the livestream here:
https://youtu.be/7T7IKi05Z9g?t=13733
